name: Aucert
long_description:
AI made building apps fast. Verifying did not keep up: every mobile team, from a first release to a billion downloads, still waits on QA, design, accessibility, compliance and security checks for everything it builds.

Aucert is a team of expert AI agents that does that work in hours, with no scripts. Each agent explores the app on its own, learns how it should work, and finds the issues in its area. Aucert plugs into agentic coding workflows, so developers and coding agents fix issues in the same loop, on every build.

Live: Accessibility · Google Play policy
Beta: Validation (functional QA) · Design
Coming soon: Apple App Store policy · Security · Create your own
one_liner: Expert AI agents that explore, understand, and verify mobile apps.
